title: stainless double walled drink glasses
text: stainless double walled drink glasses. You get 2 in the set... the rose/pink color is sort of metallic in way...the lids are clear plastic.  The set comes with 2 stainless straws with silicone lip covers and 1 straw scrub brush.  I washed them in my dishwasher - no problem.  The straws have to be washed by hand.  They are the perfect size for moscow mule or other high ball.  I am not a fan of drinking wine with a metal glass - but you could.  Overall, I like them.  Please see my photo.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
